title: Sign out
description: Signing out keeps your settings and recent channels on this Roku. You can still watch public streams.

title: Playback
description: Choose startup quality, live latency and watch credit.

children.title: Video quality
children.description: Choose the startup quality. A preferred resolution falls back to the nearest lower option, or the lowest available if none is lower. You can still change quality while watching.

children.title: Lower live latency
children.description: Try to stay closer to the live broadcast. May cause more buffering on some devices or connections. Takes effect when opening a stream.

children.title: Twitch watch credit
children.description: Experimental: report live viewing to Twitch while signed in. Rewards, watch streaks and recap credit are not guaranteed. Takes effect when opening a stream.

title: Chat
description: Control chat processing, layout, timing, text size and chat events.

children.title: Enable chat
children.description: Turn off to stop chat connections, emotes and chat events. Takes effect when chat opens.

children.title: Show chat when a stream starts
children.description: Opens live chat using your chosen layout. You can show or hide chat while watching. Chat is available for live streams.

children.title: Chat layout
children.description: Show chat beside the video or over the full-screen video. Takes effect when chat opens.

children.title: Chat overlay position
children.description: Choose a corner for chat when Over video is selected.

children.title: Chat overlay background
children.description: Background opacity over video. Chat text and emotes stay fully visible.

children.title: Chat timing
children.description: Match video delays messages to follow the stream. Live shows new messages as they arrive and may reveal reactions before the video. Takes effect when chat opens.

children.title: Chat text size
children.description: Size of chat messages. Emotes and badges scale with it.

children.title: Hype Trains in chat
children.description: Show the current Hype Train level and progress in live chat. Experimental; updates may be delayed. Takes effect when opening a stream.

children.title: Pinned messages in chat
children.description: Show the current pinned message above live chat. Press Down when player controls are hidden to read its full text. Experimental; updates may be delayed. Takes effect when opening a stream.

title: Emotes
description: Choose emote providers and animation for live chat.

children.title: Animate chat emotes
children.description: Animate one visible emote at a time on supported Roku devices. Other emotes stay still. Takes effect when chat opens.

children.title: BetterTTV emotes
children.description: Show BetterTTV emotes in live chat.

children.title: 7TV emotes
children.description: Show 7TV emotes in live chat.

children.title: FrankerFaceZ emotes
children.description: Show FrankerFaceZ emotes in live chat.

title: Browsing
description: Choose stream card size and channel order.

children.title: Stream grid
children.description: Choose larger cards or fit more streams on screen. Takes effect when opening a content page.

children.title: Floating focus
children.description: Move the highlight left and right across channel, video and category rows. Off keeps the highlight in its current fixed position.

children.title: Browse: live channel order
children.description: How live channels are ordered on the Browse page.

children.title: Following: offline channel order
children.description: How offline channels you follow are ordered on the Following page.

title: Advanced
description: Configure playback compatibility and optional diagnostics.

children.title: Built-in Enhanced Broadcasting Splitter
children.description: Play supported combined audio and video streams on this Roku without another computer. Changes take effect when opening a stream.

children.title: Demux service URL (optional)
children.description: Some Twitch streams package audio and video together in a way Roku can't play directly. If you run Stitch's optional demux service on your network, enter its address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8080. Leave empty to turn it off.

children.title: Optional diagnostics
children.description: Share app usage and device details to help improve Stitch. Off by default. Changes take effect on next app start.

title: Support Stitch
description: Stitch is a free, community-built Twitch client. If it's useful to you, scan the QR code to support development on Buy Me a Coffee. Thank you!
